clauses.quoted_text: All prices are delivered duty paid (DDP) to Buyer's designated facility and are inclusive of all customs duties, tariffs, brokerage, and import fees. Seller bears the risk of any change in such charges for the term of each Order.
clauses.reasoning: Prices are DDP and inclusive of all customs duties and tariffs, so Buyer did not bear the tariff. The clause states no refund obligation to Buyer, and the text does not provide for passing any refund to Buyer.
